clue.text: Good hearts among Australian supporters for visitors from Asia?

indicators.note: among says the first pair of pieces sits within the second pair

parts.note: fans are supporters of a team
H is the card-suit abbreviation for hearts

explanation.surface: Australian fans with kind hearts welcome tourists arriving from Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: People from Afghanistan come from Asia, so any travelling abroad are Asian visitors; the question mark marks the loose framing.

clue.text: Whale extract is found after morning on floating ice, right?

indicators.note: found after places the word is behind all the other pieces, at the end

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, means morning
a berg, short for iceberg, is floating ice

explanation.surface: Whale secretions turn up on an ice floe after dawn, correct?
explanation.definitionFit: This waxy substance comes from the sperm whale's gut and was prized in perfumery.

clue.text: About to come in calmly, giving up time in consideration of the environment

indicators.note: to come in means the word for about is put inside the other
giving up means dropping the abbreviation for time from the word for calmly

parts.note: gently means calmly
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Arriving calmly and giving up time for eco-friendly reasons.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in a green way means being environmentally conscious, an adverb matching the phrase.

clue.text: My mastery, sadly, not a feature of this grid

definitions.text: not a feature of this grid

indicators.note: sadly means things have gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A setter regretting that his skill is not shown in the puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: Standard crossword grids have rotational symmetry, so lopsidedness is never found in them.
explanation.definitionFit: Lack of balance between halves is absent from the grid, which is symmetrical like all standard cryptic grids.

clue.text: Bus going uphill with Councillor adopting one narrow road to host one minor route

indicators.note: in a down entry going uphill means the word is read bottom to top
adopting means the councillor's abbreviation takes in the numeral

parts.note: the Roman numeral I stands for one

indicators.note: to host means the road word takes the numeral inside it

parts.note: a cut is a narrow passage or road
the Roman numeral I again

explanation.surface: A bus climbs a lane with a councillor aboard, on a minor route.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going uphill' reverses Bus to SUB in this down light.
explanation.definitionFit: A subcircuit is a smaller part of a larger circuit, so a lesser route around.

clue.text: Usual limitations to treaty one concluded in China

indicators.note: the limits of a word are its outermost letters, so only the ends of treaty are kept
in places one and concluded inside the word for China

parts.note: china plate is rhyming slang for mate, so china means pal
the Roman numeral I stands for one
C is taken as an abbreviation of concluded

explanation.surface: A treaty's normal restrictions, signed off in Beijing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' is not the country but Cockney rhyming slang: china plate = mate, giving PAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something typical is what normally happens, a plain synonym of usual.

clue.text: Held up some in ambush?

indicators.note: held up means lifted, so in a down light the word is read upwards

parts.note: part means some, as in part of

explanation.surface: Delayed partly in an ambush?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Held up' reads as delayed, but it signals the upward reversal in this down light.
explanation.definitionFit: A trap and an ambush are both ploys to catch someone unawares.

clue.text: Satisfactory to participate in a game

indicators.note: to participate in means the word for satisfactory enters the other word

parts.note: a means per, as in fifty pounds a week
OK means satisfactory

explanation.surface: Content to take part in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Poker is a card game played for stakes, an example of a game.

clue.text: Red and right-winger restricting borders

indicators.note: restricting means the right-winger word hems in the borders

parts.note: a Con is a Conservative, a right-winger
rims are borders or edges

explanation.surface: A communist and a conservative keep each other within bounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Red' looks like a political leftist beside the right-winger, but it is the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Crimson is a deep shade of the colour red.

clue.text: Like a busy freighter, taking line to port

parts.note: Aden is a port in Yemen

explanation.surface: A cargo ship taking a route towards harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A cargo ship working hard is heavily loaded, weighed down with goods.

clue.text: 20s song farewelling a flapper?

definitions.meaning: a popular song from 1926, sung by Gene Austin among others
a flapper here is a bird with flapping wings, so saying goodbye twice to a dark songbird

explanation.surface: A Jazz Age tune about waving off a fashionable 1920s girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flapper' suggests the bob-haired young women of the 1920s, matching the era of the song, but here it is just a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The title literally bids goodbye to a black bird, which flaps its wings, and it is a famous song of the 1920s.

clue.text: Call chap about one's electricity supply

parts.note: to ring someone is to call them on the phone

indicators.note: about means the word for chap surrounds the numeral for one

parts.note: a chap is a man
the Roman numeral I stands for one

explanation.surface: Phone a fellow about his own electricity supply.
explanation.definitionFit: A ring main is a household wiring circuit that loops round the rooms, delivering mains electricity.

clue.text: Promotional activity ready to go for Alcatraz?

parts.note: PR, public relations, is promotional activity
something that is on is happening or ready to go, so 'is on'

explanation.surface: A publicity campaign launched for the famous island jail.
explanation.definitionFit: Alcatraz was a notorious penitentiary in San Francisco Bay, so it is an example of a jail, flagged by the question mark.

clue.text: Military group with notes about monument in investigations

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

indicators.note: about means the word for notes surrounds the monument

parts.note: to note something is to observe it, so notes means sees
an arch, such as a triumphal arch, is a monument

explanation.surface: Soldiers' musical notes on a monument in an inquiry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'notes' suggests music but is the verb meaning observes.
explanation.definitionFit: Studies and inquiries carried out to discover facts are this, a plural noun.

clue.text: Suffering wet weather, not in quantity of sunshine

indicators.note: not tells us to take the following word out of the weather word

parts.note: a day suffering wet weather is rainy

explanation.surface: A rainy day without much sun.
explanation.definitionFit: A ray of sunshine is a single beam, a small measure of sunlight.

clue.text: It provides an opening for the dedicated collector

definitions.text: It provides an opening for the dedicated collector

parts.words: It provides an opening for the dedicated collector
parts.note: a ticket collector on a train uses a hand tool that clips a hole in each ticket, not a hobbyist's door

explanation.surface: Something that offers an enthusiastic collector a lucky break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dedicated collector' suggests a keen hobbyist and 'opening' an opportunity; the collector is a railway inspector and the opening a literal hole.
explanation.definitionFit: Inspectors clip tickets with a hand tool that punches a small hole, an opening, to show they have been checked.

clue.text: Religious leader curtailed university rally struggling with high levels of support

indicators.note: curtailed means the leader's title loses its last letter

parts.note: the Pope leads the Roman Catholic Church

indicators.note: struggling suggests disorder, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pontiff cut short at a campus rally that is faltering, despite strong backing.
explanation.definitionFit: Done in a well-liked way, by general approval, so with wide backing.

clue.text: British Nobel Peace Prize winner, female, drones on

parts.note: a hen is a female bird

indicators.note: on can mean going on or under way, so the letters are set off in a new order

explanation.surface: A female peace laureate who rambles on.
explanation.walkthrough: Arthur Henderson, Labour politician, won the 1934 Nobel Peace Prize for disarmament work. 'on' is an unusual anagram signal for DRONES.
explanation.definitionFit: Arthur Henderson, a British Labour leader, received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1934 for disarmament efforts.

clue.text: Cheerful crew ready re: supply of breakfast eggs?

parts.note: a cheerful person has a sunny disposition
a side is a team or crew
up, as in up for it, means ready

explanation.surface: A happy team stands by to supply the morning's eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: Fried eggs cooked only on one side, yolk uppermost, are served this way at breakfast; the question mark notes it is a style rather than eggs themselves.

clue.text: Sensible ideas about Queen Victoria's inauguration, subject to some concerns

indicators.note: about means the word for sensible ideas surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: nous is common sense, practical intelligence
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the queen

indicators.note: an inauguration is a beginning, so the first letter is taken

explanation.surface: Wise thoughts on Victoria's coronation, a subject of worry.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone anxious is prone to worries, having some concerns.

clue.text: Succeed in taking tail off snake

indicators.note: the tail is the final letter, removed from the verb for snake

parts.note: to snake, as a road does, is to wind

explanation.surface: Managing to dock a serpent's tail.
explanation.definitionFit: To win is to be victorious, a direct synonym of succeed.

clue.text: Mischievously humorous desire to snatch silver goblet at first

indicators.note: to snatch means the desire word grabs the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a wish is a desire
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of goblet

explanation.surface: A craving to steal a silver cup.
explanation.definitionFit: Waggish describes a joker's playful, teasing wit.

clue.text: Collapse with laughter, seeing Rector caught in trees

indicators.note: caught in means the abbreviation for rector is trapped within the word for trees

parts.note: a copse is a small group of trees

explanation.surface: A vicar stuck in the woods finds it hilarious.
explanation.definitionFit: Actors' slang: to corpse is to break character by laughing uncontrollably on stage.

clue.text: Winner almost bridging small gap

indicators.note: bridging means the shortened winner word spans the small abbreviation
almost means the winner word loses its last letter

parts.note: a champ, short for champion, is a winner

explanation.surface: A near-champion closing a narrow gap.
explanation.definitionFit: A chasm is a deep opening or rift, a gap.

clue.text: Sadly stood up without second dance

indicators.note: without means outside, so the reversed word surrounds the abbreviation
stood up means set upright, read bottom to top in a down light

parts.note: alas means sadly, unfortunately

explanation.surface: Sadly jilted, missing a partner for the dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stood up' looks like a broken date, but turns ALAS into SALA, which then goes outside S.
explanation.definitionFit: Salsa is a lively Latin American dance.

clue.text: Opening page has scoundrel nursing ancient cut

indicators.note: nursing means holding something within, so the scoundrel word contains the shortened word

parts.note: a rogue is a scoundrel

indicators.note: cut means the word is shortened by its last letter

parts.note: ancient means old

explanation.surface: The first page shows a villain tending an old wound.
explanation.definitionFit: A prologue is the introductory section of a play or book, its opening part.

clue.text: Dyke-builder using a lot of lights etc.

indicators.note: a lot of means most, so the last letter is lost

parts.note: lights are animal lungs, sold with other organ meat as offal

explanation.surface: Someone building a dyke using lots of lamps and so on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lights' suggests lamps; it is the butcher's word for lungs. King Offa of Mercia built Offa's Dyke along the English-Welsh border.
explanation.definitionFit: Offa, an eighth-century king of Mercia, gave his name to the great earthwork he had raised.

clue.text: Cushy situation (or bachelor's dallying with wife)

indicators.note: dallying is idle, playful toying, so the letters are played about with

explanation.surface: An aside: life is easy, unless a bachelor is fooling around with a married woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram takes ORBACHELORS plus WIFE together and rearranges them.
explanation.definitionFit: Life is just a bowl of cherries: the idiom describes a comfortable, carefree state of affairs.

clue.text: Old woman covering a blemish in make-up

indicators.note: covering means the word for mother goes round the other pieces

parts.note: old woman is slang for mother, hence ma
a scar is a blemish on the skin

explanation.surface: Mum hiding a blemish under her cosmetics.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the cosmetic brushed onto eyelashes, one kind of make-up.

clue.text: Order from drink supplier has new brews, including unknown quantity

indicators.note: including means the scrambled letters take in the unknown
to brew is to concoct or stir up, so these letters are mixed

parts.note: in algebra y is an unknown quantity

explanation.surface: A drinks seller has new beers, in some uncertain amount.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brews' looks like a noun for beers, but it signals the anagram of HASNEW, which then takes in Y.
explanation.definitionFit: When someone pours you a drink they ask you to tell them when to stop, an instruction to the server.
